issues.quote: Can I be sure that the door will not swing open... just a little, with a faint creak, and out of the unknown darkness, so deep and endless, people will not begin to come...
all those who laid into my heart, as into their own hiding place, their hopes, their anger and their suffering, or the bloody cruelty of a beast
All those I cannot get past, who have worn me out...
What is strange in it, if they come once more?
whose blood drained out through a small hole from a soldier's bullet
One after another, a second and a third, and so without end.

strengths.quote: You know, I once read how they hanged twelve of you at once... Twelve of you... and I yawned.
I simply took, you know, a wonderful juicy plum in my fingers... and felt a pleasant, sweet taste in my mouth...
strengths.why: sensory detail makes the numbness horrifying

strengths.quote: because horror has sucked all the blood out of me
all of them leave on my soul the prints of their soles
I will stop my ears, lock my soul, and shout: no admittance here!
